biotools.summary: QSPRpred is an open-source Python toolkit for quantitative structure-property relationship (QSPR) modeling, offering a modular API and supporting various data formats and tasks. It aims to facilitate data analysis, model creation, and deployment with an emphasis on reproducibility.
